text: Visiting the UK from Europe, the USA or Australia? You'll usually need an ETA before you fly. An electronic travel authorisation lets you visit for up to six months: for tourism, family, a business trip, or short-term study. Each traveller needs one, including babies and children, and it's linked to the passport you apply with. Most decisions arrive by email within a day, but it can take up to three working days. So don't leave it until you're at the airport. Once approved, it lasts two years, or until your passport expires, whichever is sooner. In most cases, you can't use it to work for a UK company, and it doesn't guarantee entry. Planning a longer stay? Speak with the team at Corvell Immigration.
style: Warm, clear and confident British English, like a friendly immigration solicitor explaining something useful. Natural medium pace, light energy, crisp diction.
